title: CLCON/362/2019 of RIYAZUDDIN Vs KAMLA PANDEY

paras.text:
CLCON No. 362 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
None present for the applicant.
Mr. J.S. Bisht, learned Brief Holder for the opposite
parties.
A Division Bench of this Court issued certain
directions in WPPIL No. 152 of 2018 vide order dated
20.09.2018. Alleging willful disobedience of the
directions issued in its order dated 20.09.2018, this
contempt petition has been filed. A compliance affidavit
has been filed by opposite party No. 2 - Ms. Nirmala
Bisht, Sub-Divisional Magistrate, Khatima, Udham Singh
Nagar. Para 4 of the said compliance affidavit is extracted
below:-
"4. That in compliance of the order dated 20.09.2018
passed in Writ Petition (PIL) no. 152 of 2018 (Riyazuddin
Vs. State of Uttarakhand & others) the deponent taking
cognizance of the compliant letter, vide letter no. 2078
dated 01.05.2019 directed to the Executive Officer, Nagar
Palika Parishad Khatima to ensure the compliance of the
Hon'ble Court's order dated 20.09.2018 and pursuant to
the aforesaid direction the Executive Officer, Khatima vide
letter no. 2140 dated 01.05.2019 apprised to the deponent
that pursuant to the judgment and order dated 20.09.2019
the slaughter house situated at Khatima is closed due to
expiry of licencse and non-fulfillment of norms prescribed
by Food Safety Department. It is further submitted that
pursuant to the letter no. 1387/U;k; lgk;d 20(30/4)2019
dated 13.05.2019 issued by District magistrate, Udham
Singh Nagar the deponent, issued directions to the
Executive Officer, Municipal Board Khatima and C.O.
Khatima to do needful in this regard. The deponent vide
letter no. 2079 dated 02.05.2019 directed S.H.O., Police
Station, Khatima to take necessary action regarding safety
of the applicant,
A true/correct typed version/photocopy of the office
latter No. 2078 dated 01.05.2019, letter no. 2140 dated
01.05.2019, letter no. 1387/U;k; lgk;d 20(30/4)2019dated
13.05.2019 & latter no. 2079 dated 02.05.2019 are being
enclosed herewith and marked as Annexure CA-a, 2, 3 & 4
respectively to this affidavit."
On 09.08.2019, applicant's counsel was granted one
week time to file objection to the compliance affidavit and
thereafter on 20.08.2019 again two weeks further time was
granted to applicant's counsel to file objection, but no
objection has been filed till date.
Under the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the
case, this Court left with no option, but to accept the
statement made by opposite party No. 2 in the compliance
affidavit as correct.
In such view of the matter, contempt petition is
closed. Notices issued to the opposite parties are hereby
discharged.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
11.09.2019
Aswal
